_note: Memorial letters (R7, PLAN §8 rule 6, D-059): written when someone dies, to the guildmaster, by the comrade who shared the most contracts with them, or by the guild clerk. Written plainly and sincerely, never as a joke (STYLE §9b). Facts and slots: packages/engine/src/report/SPEC.md. Grammar: packages/engine/src/core/text.ts.

memorial.salutation.text: To the guildmaster, from the guild's book:

memorial.opening.text: I was there when {dead} fell at {quest}, and I would rather you heard it from me.
You will have the report from {quest} by now. I wanted to write about {dead} myself.
I was not there when {dead} died at {quest}. I wish I had been.
They told me about {dead} when I came in. I have been trying to write this since.
The guild has lost {dead}, who died at {quest}.
It is my duty to record the death of {dead} at {quest}.
I was with {dead} at {quest}. I am writing because someone who knew {dead.them} should.
I have started this letter three times. {dead} died at {quest}, and I was there.
I heard about {dead} on the road back. I will say what I can.
News of {dead} reached me after it was over. I want you to know who {dead.they} {dead~was|were}.
With regret, I record that {dead} died at {quest}.
{dead} died at {quest}. I was there, and I want to tell you about {dead.them}.
We brought {dead} back from {quest}. Not the way any of us wanted.
I was at {quest} when we lost {dead}. This is the hardest letter I have written.

memorial.death.text: {killer} struck {dead.them} down in the fight, and {dead.they} did not get up.
It was {killer}. {dead.They} {dead~was|were} still on {dead.their} feet when the blow came.
We had already turned back when {killer} caught {dead.them}.
The party was pulling out when {killer} caught {dead.them}.
{dead.They} never reached the fight. The way in took {dead.them} first.
{dead.They} {dead~was|were} struck down by {killer} as the party withdrew.
{dead.They} died on the way in, before any foe was met.
{killer} got through to {dead.them}. There was nothing any of us could do.
I am told it was {killer}, and that it was quick.
{dead.They} {dead~was|were} among the last to turn for home, and {killer} reached {dead.them}.
It was the way in, not the fight, that killed {dead.them}. I keep thinking it should not have been.

memorial.service.text: {dead.They} had only just signed the book.
{dead.They} went out {count} times with this guild, the first to {first}.
{count} contracts, starting at {first}. {dead.They} came home from all of them but this one.
{dead.They} went out {count} times. I was beside {dead.them} for most of them.
{dead.They} had been on {count} contracts, and came home from every one until this.
{dead.Their} first was {first}. {dead.They} went out {count} times in all.
I was beside {dead.them} on most of {dead.their} {count} contracts, from {first} on.
{count} times {dead.they} went out for this guild. {dead.They} should have had many more.
{dead.They} {dead~was|were} one of the old hands: {count} contracts, the first at {first}.
Since {first}, {dead.they} had been on {count} contracts, more than most of us.
I went out with {dead.them} more times than I can easily count. {count}, the book says.
{dead.They} had only been out {count} times, the first to {first}.
{count} contracts. Not many, but {dead.they} came back from each of them better than {dead.they} went.
{dead.Their} first contract was {first}. There were only {count}.
{dead.They} came to us not long ago. This was {dead.their} first time out.

memorial.deed.text: At {deedQuest} {dead.they} pulled me back from dying. I would not be writing this otherwise.
At {deedQuest} {dead.they} held {patient} back from dying. {patient} is alive because of it.
Whenever it went badly, {dead.they} stood in front. At {deedQuest} {dead.they} took blows that were meant for others.
At {deedQuest} {dead.they} fought as well as anyone I have seen.
{dead.Their} work at {deedQuest} is still talked about in the hall.
{dead.They} patched more of us up than I can count.
{dead.They} tended the wounded on every contract {dead.they} went on.
{dead.They} never asked for much, and did what was asked.
I owe {dead.them} my life. At {deedQuest}, when I was going, {dead.they} would not let me.
{patient} would have died at {deedQuest} if not for {dead.them}.
{dead.They} always put {dead.themself} between the rest of us and the worst of it.
When it came to the fight, {dead.they} {dead~was|were} the one we counted on. {deedQuest} showed it.
If you were hurt, {dead.they} {dead~was|were} the first one kneeling next to you.
{dead.They} did the work without fuss, every time.
{dead.They} {dead~was|were} steady. You knew where you were with {dead.them}.
{dead.They} kept {dead.their} head when others did not, and nobody ever had to ask twice.
At {deedQuest} {dead.they} held the line so the rest of us could get our breath.
{dead.They} took the hits so we would not have to. {deedQuest} was the worst of it, and {dead.they} never said a word.
More than one of us is alive because {dead.they} stepped in front at {deedQuest}.
At {deedQuest} {dead.they} stood guard over the others and held.
I watched {dead.them} at {deedQuest}. I have never seen anyone fight like it.
{dead.They} mended the rest of us on more nights than anyone remembers.

memorial.person.text: {dead.They} {dead~was|were} {age}, and had seen more than most of us.
{dead.They} always took the front, and never once complained of it.
{dead.They} always went first, to look, so the rest of us would not have to.
{dead.They} said a few words over each of us before we set out. Somebody else will have to now.
At {age}, {dead.they} still went out with the rest of us.
{dead.They} carried the heavy end of every shield wall we ever made.
{dead.They} saw the trap before the rest of us saw the door.
{dead.They} kept the rest of us going when we had nothing left.
{dead.They} {dead~was|were} {age}, with most of {dead.their} life ahead of {dead.them}.

memorial.closing.text: Put {dead.their} name in the book, if you would.
I am sorry. I thought you should know.
The name has been entered in the guild's book.
I will see {dead.them} buried properly, if the guild allows.
There is a gap at the table now. We all feel it.
Wages owed have been set aside for the family.
I will write to {dead.their} people, unless you would rather do it yourself.
The name will be read at the next Assembly.
